role: declarative algorithm-compiler input that generates matched controls and proof surfaces; it does not execute experiments or create evidence
single_mutation_rule: A scientific successor changes exactly one semantic axis unless terminal interaction evidence explicitly authorizes a fresh joint candidate.
generated_artifacts: R matched random-direction control when directionality is claimed
S causal-misalignment control when association is claimed
compiler_fail_closed_rules: Reject any read before its declared decoder-visible availability point.
Reject undeclared state reads or writes.
Reject a join that does not name every persistent state class.
Reject treatment/control write-set asymmetry not explicitly required by the tested mechanism.
Reject floating arithmetic without exact order, rounding, contraction, FTZ, DAZ, and library contracts.
Reject missing package or resource ceilings.
Generated output has no execution authority until independently validated and content-addressed.
